name: @waste/domain
description: Pure, deterministic planning logic (ADR-0002): the route schemes, the map-planning questions, UUIDv7 in ids, the permission vocabulary and the system roles in access/, the closed lists of the Registry (registry/vocabulary), of Planning (planning/vocabulary) and of Resources (resources/vocabulary), which the database reads into its CHECK constraints and the contracts into their z.enum, so the two cannot drift, and Resources' two rules beside its lists: the licence implication (resources/licence) and the fold of a Stock Movement onto a Container Asset State (resources/asset-state); Execution's (execution/vocabulary) with its two machines, the proof shapes and the pure driver command applier; and Resolution's (resolution/vocabulary) with the ticket and alert machines (resolution/transitions), what each history row carries (resolution/event-shapes) and which outbox event becomes which ticket (resolution/from-event); and Finance & Contracting's (finance/vocabulary) with money in minor units and the one rounding (finance/money), the price resolver (finance/pricing), the readings a billable event, an invoice and an unload's review are (finance/readings), the settlement and review machines (finance/transitions) and which outbox event becomes which billable event (finance/from-event). Depends on nothing; no React, Next, MapLibre, browser or Node globals. Ships TypeScript source for bundler and tsx consumers (extensionless imports); src/__tests__/purity.test.ts enforces the boundary.
